settings.title: Guided Tour
settings.subtitle: Discover core features, keyboard shortcuts, and photo book export workflows

sidebarNav.title: Your Command Center
sidebarNav.body:
The sidebar gives you instant access to everything:

• **Import** — ingest photos from memory cards, USB drives & folders
• **Library** — browse, rapidly cull & organize your archive
• **Help & Settings** — complete shortcut matrix, preferences & about

importSource.title: Step 1: Choose Source
importSource.body:
Select a memory card, USB drive, or any folder as your **source**.

RapidReady automatically detects inserted memory cards and removable media with DCIM folders.

importDuplicates.title: Duplicate Detection
importDuplicates.body:
Previously imported photos are detected instantly and hidden by default.

This prevents duplicate files on disk and saves valuable storage space.

importDestination.title: Step 2: Set Archive Destination
importDestination.body:
Choose the permanent home for your photos on your hard drive or NAS.

Save frequently used destinations as archive locations for 1-click access.

importStructure.title: Folder Structure & Live Preview
importStructure.body:
Choose how photos are organized within your destination — e.g. by **shooting date**, **project name**, or **flat**.

The interactive **live preview** instantly shows the exact target path for your files.

importCollection.title: Import into Collection
importCollection.body:
Assign newly imported photos directly to an existing album or create a new collection on the fly.

Your images arrive organized and ready to cull — without creating duplicate files on disk.

libraryFolderTree.title: Archive Folder Tree
libraryFolderTree.body:
Browse your entire archive by folder hierarchy. Hold **Ctrl/⌘** to select multiple folders at once, or **Shift** for a contiguous range.

Right-click any folder for options: Reveal in Explorer/Finder, Rename, Create Subfolder, or Delete (with safety guardrails).

libraryCollections.title: Collections & Virtual Albums
libraryCollections.body:
Curate photos into **virtual albums** — independent of physical disk folders. One photo can live in many albums without duplicating files.

**Drag & drop** photos onto an album. Reorder freely inside any album — this custom order forms the basis for photo book exports.

libraryGrid.title: Photo Grid & Zoom Slider
libraryGrid.body:
Your photos appear in a responsive, virtualized grid — smoothly handling archives with tens of thousands of images.

Use the **zoom slider** at the bottom to scale thumbnails from compact overview to large previews. Press **G** for Grid, **E** for Loupe.

libraryLoupe.title: Loupe View & Rapid Culling
libraryLoupe.body:
Press **E** or double-click a photo to enter Loupe view with the filmstrip below. Press **Z** for instant 1:1 pixel zoom.

Cull at speed: **P** = Pick, **X** = Reject, **1–5** = Star Rating, **6–9** = Color Labels. All ratings are saved non-destructively in `.rrdata` sidecars.

libraryInspector.title: Inspector: Metadata & GPS
libraryInspector.body:
The Inspector displays full EXIF data: camera model, lens, exposure, ISO, dimensions, and shooting timestamps.

Edit **GPS coordinates** directly or use the 1-click "Open in Maps" link. Batch-tag, color-label, and rate photos without leaving this panel.

collectionExport.title: Photo Book Export — The Clever Trick
collectionExport.body:
Right-click any album → **Export**. Files are copied in your curated drag & drop order with sequential numbering (`001_Photo.jpg`).

The clever trick: **Linear EXIF timestamp synthesis** (+10s per photo) guarantees your exact order is preserved in *every* photo book software and cloud album.

helpAndSettings.title: Help, Settings & RapidRAW
helpAndSettings.body:
Press **F1** or **⌘/** anytime for the full shortcut reference and documentation.

**Settings** configures startup behavior, archive locations, and presets.

Press **R** on any photo to open it in **RapidRAW** for professional editing.

*You're all set — happy shooting! 📷*
